text:
The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

Here is an alternative ending for the story:

Clara held her breath, the cold steel of the trapdoor biting into her palms. As the first blade descended with a deafening screech, she didn't just time her movement; she anticipated the rhythm of the machine itself. In a blur of motion, she twisted her body, the blade grazing her shoulder but missing vital organs by a fraction of an inch. She rolled forward, not away from the danger, but into the heart of the mechanism. With a swift, practiced kick, she jammed her boot into the main gear, causing the entire contraption to shudder and seize. The blades froze mid-descent, humming with tension. Silence fell over the theater, broken only by Clara’s ragged breathing. She stood up, dusted off her costume, and bowed to the stunned audience. It wasn't just a trick; it was a triumph of precision over chaos, securing her legacy not as a daredevil, but as a master of control.
